scoring_justification: Agent reports final computed metrics from analytic equations; no raw intermediate artifacts exist to recompute from, so the checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper's reported optimal values with thresholds and tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold performance metrics for p-n junction and Schottky barrier betavoltaic cells from the paper, used as thresholds for scoring.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 and results text: p-n Jsc≈157 nA/cm², Voc≈0.35 V, FF≈0.75, η≈3.17%; Schottky Jsc≈86.6 nA/cm², Voc≈0.26 V, FF≈0.69, η≈1.18%; efficiency ratio ≈ 3.17/1.18.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's reported optimal values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact documented optimal performance figures from the original paper; they represent the theoretical maximum for the stated design parameters and are the target the agent must match or exceed.

outputs.description: Computed betavoltaic performance metrics for Si p-n junction and Ni/Si Schottky barrier structures.

output_contract.notes: All metrics are compared against paper-reported optimal values with tolerances; exceeding the target (higher Jsc, Voc, FF, η) is not penalized.
